detail: A wide informal economy and low tax-to-GDP could starve the plan of funds.
mitigation: Broaden the tax base, formalise businesses and modernise revenue collection.

detail: Rising development spending against limited revenue raises fiscal risk.
mitigation: Favour concessional borrowing, spend efficiently and lean on private capital.

detail: The plan relies on the private sector for most of the financing.
mitigation: Improve the investment climate, de-risk projects and use PPPs and a financing facility.

detail: Earlier plans were sound on paper but lagged in delivery.
mitigation: The National Delivery Framework tracks and enforces delivery.

detail: Gaps in power, water, ports and transport can choke growth.
mitigation: Front-load enabling infrastructure alongside the flagships.

detail: Droughts, floods and coastal risks threaten farming and cities.
mitigation: Climate-resilient value chains, land management and early-warning systems.

detail: Global price and demand swings hit exports and reserves.
mitigation: Diversify exports and strengthen external-sector resilience.

detail: A modern economy needs skills the workforce is still building.
mitigation: Technical training, digital skills and workforce reforms.
